Class RouterFunctionMapping

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.context.support.ApplicationObjectSupport
org.springframework.web.reactive.handler.AbstractHandlerMapping
org.springframework.web.reactive.function.server.support.RouterFunctionMapping
All Implemented Interfaces:
Aware, BeanNameAware, InitializingBean, ApplicationContextAware, Ordered, HandlerMapping
public class RouterFunctionMapping extends AbstractHandlerMapping implements InitializingBean
HandlerMapping implementation that supports RouterFunctions.

如果未在构造时提供 RouterFunction，此映射将检测应用程序上下文中的所有路由函数，并按顺序进行查询。

Since:
5.0
Author:
Arjen Poutsma

      public void afterPropertiesSet() throws Exception
      描述从接口复制：InitializingBean
      Invoked by the containing BeanFactory after it has set all bean properties and satisfied BeanFactoryAware, ApplicationContextAware etc.

      此方法允许 Bean 实例在其所有属性设置完成后，执行其整体配置验证和最终初始化。

    • getHandlerInternal

      protected reactor.core.publisher.Mono<?> getHandlerInternal(ServerWebExchange exchange)
      描述从类复制：AbstractHandlerMapping
      Look up a handler for the given request, returning an empty Mono if no specific one is found. This method is called by AbstractHandlerMapping.getHandler(ServerWebExchange).

      在 CORS 预检请求中，此方法不应针对预检请求返回匹配结果，而应基于 URL 路径、来自"Access-Control-Request-Method"标头的 HTTP 方法以及来自"Access-Control-Request-Headers"标头的标头，针对预期的实际请求返回匹配结果。

      Specified by:
      `getHandlerInternal` 类中的 `AbstractHandlerMapping`
      Parameters:
      exchange - 当前交易所
      Returns:
      匹配处理程序的 Mono（如果有）
